title: Unnamed Titan 013
summary: Unnamed Titan 013 is a muscular purple-skinned Yama-Titan that resembles an ape-like demon. It dons a purple outfit inspired by Chinese-Japanese culture and wields a sharp double-edged scimitar. Its Amulet was in the possession of DeFoe.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: DeFoe summoned this Titan to replace [[Mr. Steel]] during a battle, and eliminate him in the process, causing Steel to run away in terror. {{Source|TCG:SAS-141|SAS-141}}
